atlasRequests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the supplied game character roster poster. Deliver a PORTRAIT ATLAS for a wiki, with exactly THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of equal rectangular cells, edge-to-edge, no gutters, no frames, NO TEXT or labels, no poster header, no tier letters. The overall atlas has 4:5 aspect ratio, each cell is a 4:5 portrait. Extract ONLY the character artworks specified below from their labeled cards in the supplied poster and enlarge/restoratively clarify them for display at 224 pixels wide. Faithfully preserve each source character's specific face, species, expression, hair, headdress, costume, accessories, colors, original hand-drawn ink and flat-color illustration style, visible body crop, and individual backdrop. Sharpen existing lines and reduce compression blur; do not add accessories, beautify faces, change identities, redesign clothing, invent lore, or make photorealistic. Do not include the original names in the output. Do not use adjacent characters or swap cells. The characters must appear in EXACT row-major order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom): 1: Dương Tiễn; 2: Hằng Nga; 3: Lý Tịnh; 4: Tôn Ngộ Không; 5: Ngọc Diện Hồ Ly; 6: Đa Văn Thiên Vương; 7: Hồng Hài Nhi; 8: Hàng Long Tôn Giả; 9: Na Tra. All nine cells are occupied. Strict evenly registered 3 by 3 layout, no gaps or overlaps. High-resolution crisp portraits, not an entire poster.

individualRequest.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve image restoration. Adult woman with dark softly curled hair, pink flower hair ornaments, green/teal robe, golden jewelry. Preserve the exact original character identity, expression, hair, outfit, pose, palette, ink drawing style and visible head/shoulders crop.
